title: Ordering at a café
objectives: Choose between drinking in and takeaway.
difficulty_descriptions: Modelled phrases and a named item.
Short service questions with light cues.

examples.learner: I would like a coffee, please.

common_misunderstandings.correction: Use ‘I would like’ for a gentler request.
common_misunderstandings.explanation_bg: ‘I would like’ звучи по-учтиво от директното ‘I want’.

prompts: Say: I would like a coffee, please.
What would you like to drink?
Welcome to the café. May I take your order?
exercises.gentle_correction: A polite order needs the item and a courteous request.
exercises.explanation_bg: Кажете какво искате с учтивата фраза ‘I would like ... please’.

exercises.goal: Finish an order after a follow-up question.
prompts: Say: That is all, thank you.
exercises.gentle_correction: Use a complete phrase to show that the order is finished.
exercises.explanation_bg: ‘That is all’ означава, че не желаете нищо допълнително.

exercises.goal: Understand and answer the dine-in or takeaway question.
prompts: Is that for here or to go?
Will you be having that here, or taking it away?
exercises.gentle_correction: Choose either eating here or taking the order away.
exercises.explanation_bg: ‘For here’ е за консумация на място, а ‘to go’ е за вкъщи.

completion_condition: Complete all three café exchanges with English production.
